items.focus: Original drilling to 7187 ft described as normal
items.caveat: No incident should be inferred for the original phase from this statement

items.focus: Re-entry lost circulation at source-reported 7733 ft
items.caveat: FactPage says 2369 m; later sample sheets show continuing losses through 7773 ft. Onset and normalized MD remain disputed and alert eligibility blocked

items.focus: Pipe became stuck; 7262 ft locates bottom of fish, not onset
items.caveat: Do not assign 7262 ft as stuck-pipe onset

items.focus: Sidetrack was required after the stuck-pipe episode
items.caveat: Historical response only; not an operational recommendation

items.focus: Six cones lost while drilling sidetrack at 8192 ft
items.caveat: Equipment loss is not another stuck-pipe event

items.focus: Core interval 7789-7801 ft is a coring record
items.caveat: Do not infer loss or stuck pipe from nearby depth values

items.focus: Re-entry stratigraphy labels drill depths as KB 31 ft
items.caveat: Report-level clue does not explicitly assign the incident page an MD/KB datum

items.focus: Leak-off test at 825 m equivalent mud weight 1.49 SG
items.caveat: A leak-off test is not an uncontrolled mud-loss event

items.focus: Lost circulation at 1305 m
items.caveat: Axis/datum not stated in this passage

items.focus: Circulation regained after pump rates were reduced
items.caveat: Linked to R009; not a separate loss event

items.focus: Partial returns at 1485 m
items.caveat: May be a continuation or second loss episode; grouping requires review

items.focus: Mica and reduced pump strokes still left partial returns
items.caveat: Linked to R011; partial outcome, not a new onset

items.focus: Tight hole at 1400 m on running back in
items.caveat: Observed tight hole must not be labeled stuck pipe

items.focus: LCM mud circulation before cementing at 1475 m shoe
items.caveat: Preparation is not another cementing failure or loss onset

items.focus: Lost circulation at 1855 m MD RKB in 17.5 in section
items.caveat: Event belongs to original S section, before T2 sidetrack

items.focus: Riser mud level dropped approximately 40 m
items.caveat: 40 m is a level drop, not an event depth or volume

items.focus: LCM, cement and reduced mud weight attempts did not regain circulation
items.caveat: Do not label any one attempt successful; linked to R015

items.focus: Later T2 section drilled with lower starting mud weight without losses
items.caveat: A no-loss outcome on T2 is not a T2 loss event

items.focus: Connection gas at 3876 m with negative flow check
items.caveat: Do not label the 3876 m check as a positive influx

items.focus: Positive 400 L flow at 3893 m before shut-in
items.caveat: Well-control incident; do not claim validated pressure prediction

items.focus: Returns lost during 20 SPM kill after about 400 strokes
items.caveat: No independent onset depth stated for this later return-loss episode

items.focus: Slight mud losses while reaming the final seven joints to bottom
items.caveat: No onset depth given; do not borrow 1400 m or 1485 m from adjacent statements

items.focus: 65 bbl loss recorded at 7745 ft with pressure-surge question
items.caveat: Continuation of a loss episode, not automatically a second onset

items.focus: Still losing circulation in 7760-7770 ft sample interval
items.caveat: Shows losses persisted beyond page 7's 7733 ft statement

items.focus: Drilled to 7773 ft and lost 400 bbl over eight hours
items.caveat: 7773 ft converts to 2369.21 m, close to the rounded FactPage summary; keep conflict flag until domain review
